This is the first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail, as he has been arrested in connection with Crime No. 17/2023 registered at Police Station - Mardapal, District - Kondagaon, Chhattisgarh for the offences punishable under Section 363, 366, 376 (2) (n) of I.P.C. 1860 and under Section 06 of Prevention of Children from Sexual Offences, Act, 2012.

sentences.text: 2. Case of the prosecution is that, on 02.08.2023 father of the victim lodged a report in the concerned police station that his daughter was found missing from 07.07.2023.

Based on the report,
initially, crime was registered for offences under Section 363 of I.P.C. against unknown person.

During the course of investigation, victim was recovered near Railway Station Lohandiguda, and after recording her statement under Section 161 of Cr.P.C., the aforementioned offences were also added and applicant was arrested on 05.08.2023.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant has been Neutral Citation 2024:CGHC:1864 falsely implicated in the instant case and he has not committed any offence as alleged.

He submits that during trial, victim is examined before the Trial Court and she has stated that she along with other 02 friends and the applicant went to Hyderabad for earning their livelihood with the permission of her parents.

She has not leveled any allegations of committing Jay Singh Muchaki vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/175698295/

sentences.text: 4. On the other hand, learned State counsel opposes the submission made by learned counsel for the applicant and submits that serious allegations have been leveled against the applicant by victim in her statement recorded under Section 161 and 164 of Cr.P.C.
She further stated that evidence relied upon by the counsel for the applicant is subject matter of appreciation of Trial Court.

5. Pursuant to the notice issued by this Court, victim is present before this Court through virtual mode from D.L.S.A. Kondagaon, District - Kondagaon and she has raised no objection in grant of bail to the applicant.
6. I have heard learned counsel for the respective parties and perused the documents placed in record.

7. Taking in consideration the facts and circumstances of the case, nature of allegations, submission made by counsel for the respective parties as also, submission of counsel for the applicant based on the deposition of the victim, without commenting on the merits of the case, I am inclined to allow this application for grant of bail.

8. Accordingly, the bail application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is directed that applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 25,000/-
with one surety in the like sum to satisfaction of Trial Court concerned on the Neutral Citation 2024:CGHC:1864 conditions that:
(i) He shall appear before the Trial Court concerned regularly on each and every date unless exempted from appearance.
(ii) He shall not, in any manner, tamper with the prosecution witnesses.
(iii) If applicant is found involved in similar offence in future, it will be open for the State to apply for cancellation of bail.
9. Certified copy as per rules.
